sources.prices: Nasdaq public historical endpoint, split-adjusted opens and closes, not dividend-adjusted
sources.market: S&P 500 index level, FRED series SP500 (© S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC; not redistributed)

note: Derived statistics only. Price and index series are not redistributed; run fetch.ts to rebuild them. Exploratory analysis on an after-the-fact sample.

calendarSpan.note: gap − 1 is nearly a linear function of the Monday dummy; the calendar control is identified only by the holiday-shifted observations counted here.

base.method: dependent wild bootstrap, block length 10 trading days, Gaussian multipliers shared across tickers, HAC t-statistics
base.statistic: max |t| over 8 tickers x 4 day dummies

calendarControlled.method: dependent wild bootstrap, block length 10 trading days, Gaussian multipliers shared across tickers, HAC t-statistics
calendarControlled.statistic: max |t| over 8 tickers x 4 day dummies

design.weekdayExperiment: all 521 weeks, one plan per weekday, valued at the same final close
design.startExperiment: 469 installments, start delayed by 0..51 weeks; the five weekday plans of one start are valued at the same close, the last trading day of their final week
design.holidayRule: order fills on the next trading day
